 # Xtremepush
 
 ## About
 Xtremepush is a CRM and loyalty marketing platform powered by a built-in real-time CDP. We unify customer data, AI personalization, omnichannel campaigns, F2P gamification, and loyalty marketing in one data layer for sports betting and gaming operators.
 
 ## Company Info
 - Founded: 2015
 - Headquarters: Dublin, Ireland
 - Customers: 400+ operators including FanDuel, Fanatics, BetMGM, William Hill, Superbet, Kwiff, Caliente
 - Primary Market: Sports Betting and Gaming
 - Certifications: ISO 27001:2013, GDPR compliant
 
 ## Platform Modules
 - Real-Time CDP: Millisecond data ingestion via API, Kafka, and SDK
 - Omnichannel Activation: Push, email, SMS, in-app, web inbox, social
 - InfinityAI: Predictive churn, tier progression, responsible gambling scoring
 - XP Gamify: Native F2P games (spin wheels, scratch cards, pick-me)
 - XP Loyalty: Missions, challenges, levels, operator currencies
 - Journey Builder: A/B/n testing with automatic winner selection
